metrics.name: Faithfulness
metrics.description: Fraction of answer claims supported by retrieved context. 1.0 = zero hallucinations.

metrics.name: Answer Relevance
metrics.description: Cosine similarity between question and answer embeddings. Measures topical alignment.

metrics.name: Context Precision
metrics.description: Of retrieved chunks, fraction that are actually relevant (retrieval signal-to-noise).

metrics.name: Context Recall
metrics.description: Does retrieved context cover all information needed for the ground-truth answer?

metrics.name: Decline Rate
metrics.description: Percentage of out-of-scope questions correctly refused rather than hallucinated.

note: answer_relevancy = 0.0 on 6/24 non-negative multi-hop/comparison questions is intentional: the system adds epistemic caveats that RAGAS marks as noncommittal. Use faithfulness and context_recall as primary metrics for those categories.
